Section: Table of Contents > 1. Overview

Fieldster Mobile is a cross-platform mobile field-service application built for pest control,

termite inspection, and property service companies to equip their technicians with everything

needed to complete a day of scheduled visits from a phone or tablet — in the field, with or

without a live internet connection.

The application connects technicians in the field to the office back-end system, giving service

companies a single mobile workspace to schedule and route appointments, capture on-site

inspection and treatment records, generate and sign digital service agreements, document work

with photos and diagrams, collect customer payments, and keep field and office data in sync —

all from one native mobile app on Android and iOS.

Section: Table of Contents > 2. Business Context

Pest control, termite inspection, and property service companies that manage a mobile

technician workforce typically need to:

● Schedule and route technician appointments efficiently across many customer properties

● Capture detailed on-site inspection and treatment records — pest activity, chemical

applications, structural conditions, and bait/monitoring station readings

● Produce industry-specific inspection paperwork, such as wood infestation/destroying-insect

reports and pretreatment records

● Collect customer signatures on service agreements and diagram the areas of a property that

were treated

● Capture and manage photo documentation of each visit

● Process customer payments in the field, by credit card or ACH

● Track and resolve field and service issues through to completion

● Keep technician and office records synchronized, even where connectivity is unreliable

Handling this across a mobile technician workforce without a dedicated field application leads

to paper-based records, delayed office visibility, inconsistent documentation, and slower

payment collection. Fieldster Mobile centralizes the entire field-technician workflow — from the

day's schedule through documentation, signature, payment, and sync — into a single,

purpose-built mobile application.

Section: Table of Contents > 4. Functional Modules > 4.1 Login & Navigation

Technicians authenticate through a secure sign-in screen tied to their company account. Once

signed in, they land on a central, tab-based navigation hub — covering the calendar, tickets, and

the app menu — that gives quick access to every workflow in the application.

Section: Table of Contents > 4. Functional Modules > 4.2 Lead, Customer & Property Management

● Capture new sales leads directly from the field

● Search existing customers and properties, and manage related contacts

● Maintain and browse property and location records tied to each customer

● View customer balance and account information relevant to a scheduled visit

Section: Table of Contents > 4. Functional Modules > 4.3 Appointment & Route Scheduling

The Appointment is the central unit of work in Fieldster Mobile — once one is created, every

downstream step of the visit (documentation, forms, signature, payment, and any resulting

ticket) is carried out within that same appointment record.

● Create new appointments with associated agreement type, service line, service type, and

billing detail

● View the day's and historical appointments in list, calendar, or map view

● Search and filter appointments by multiple criteria, including a combined list-and-map search

Ticket Management | Create, assign, resolve, and reopen field/service tickets
Time Tracking | Log technician time-in/time-out for every appointment
Photo Documentation | Capture, annotate, and manage service photos
Offline Data Sync | Keep working without connectivity; automatically reconcile
with the office once back online

● Sort and reorder the day's route, and move jobs between technicians or time slots

● Review historical appointment and service records for a property

Section: Table of Contents > 4. Functional Modules > 4.4 Field Service Documentation

● Record chemical applications and treatment detail, pest sightings and activity, and site

condition notes

● Log pH and weather readings relevant to a treatment

● Manage bait and monitoring station records, including Sentricon-type termite station

networks

● Draw and annotate treatment diagrams directly on a graphical property map, using reusable

symbol tools and prior-visit diagram history for context

Section: Table of Contents > 4. Functional Modules > 4.5 Forms & Inspection Reports

● Complete structured, industry-specific inspection paperwork such as wood

infestation/destroying-insect reports

● Complete pretreatment forms and other configurable, custom service forms

● Retrieve and review previously completed forms tied to a job

Section: Table of Contents > 4. Functional Modules > 4.6 E-Documents & Digital Agreements

● Present, fill, and capture customer signatures on service agreements and autopay

authorizations directly on the device

● Select the correct agreement or document set for a given job

● Send completed, signed documents from the field

Section: Table of Contents > 4. Functional Modules > 4.7 Billing & Payment Processing

● Securely process customer credit card and ACH payments in the field, integrated with the

Adyen payment platform

● View stored payment methods and customer balance detail before collecting payment

● Support alternate payment options, with encrypted payment-token handling to protect card

data

Section: Table of Contents > 4. Functional Modules > 4.8 Ticket Management

● Create, assign, resolve, and reopen service tickets tied to a customer or property

● Track ticket status and history so field and office staff stay aligned on open issues

Section: Table of Contents > 4. Functional Modules > 4.9 Time Tracking & Photo Documentation

● Log technician time-in/time-out per appointment for accurate labor tracking

● Capture, annotate — markup, highlight, and text — and manage photos tied to a service visit,

through a dedicated picture gallery and edit toolset

Section: Table of Contents > 4. Functional Modules > 4.10 Offline Sync & Data Management

● Local, on-device data storage lets technicians keep working in areas with poor or no signal

● A background sync process reconciles field-entered data with the office system once

connectivity is restored, with visible sync status

● Push notifications keep technicians informed of new or changed appointments and service

alerts

Section: Table of Contents > 5. End-to-End Workflow

Every service visit in Fieldster Mobile is built around the Appointment. Once an appointment is

created, everything that follows for that visit — navigation, field documentation, forms,

signatures, payment, time tracking, and any resulting ticket — happens inside that same

appointment, keeping the full visit record as one connected unit through to office sync.

Section: Table of Contents > 6. Field Visibility & Operational Insight

Fieldster Mobile keeps technicians — and, through synchronized data, the office — informed

throughout the day, including:

● A daily schedule view (list, calendar, and map) showing scheduled, in-progress, and

completed appointments

● A notification center surfacing new appointments, schedule changes, and service alerts

● Historical appointment and service views for reviewing past visits to a property

● Clear sync status so technicians always know their field-entered data is up to date with the

office

● Photo, form, diagram, and e-document records tied back to each appointment for later

reference by the office and the customer

Section: Table of Contents > 8. Role & Contribution

Tecsack Software has served as the engineering team behind Fieldster Mobile's ongoing

development — delivering new field-technician capabilities, resolving platform-specific issues

across Android and iOS, and continuously refining the appointment, documentation, and

payment workflows that technicians rely on every day.

Highlights of Tecsack Software's contribution include:

● End-to-end feature delivery: across every functional area of the application — from lead

capture and appointment creation through field documentation, e-signature, payment, and

sync

● Custom UI engineering: design and development of a library of reusable, native-feel controls

— bottom sheets, calendars, search, and photo markup tools — used throughout the app

Section: Table of Contents > 9. Value Delivered

● Gives field technicians a single mobile workspace covering the entire visit lifecycle — from

creating the appointment through documentation, signature, payment, and sync

● Reduces paperwork and manual data entry through structured, on-device inspection and

treatment forms

● Speeds up cash collection with secure, in-field credit card and ACH payment processing

● Keeps office and field records aligned through automatic, offline-first data synchronization

● Improves accountability with photo, signature, and time-tracking documentation tied to

every appointment

● Provides a consistent, native experience across Android and iOS so office and field teams

share one reliable system
